why: What the runner must know about a check beyond its name. timed: it measures time, so it runs alone on the dev server, as it was written for (DESIGN.md section 11). agent: it starts an agent's turn; skipped unless --agent; the fake model (tools/checks/fake-model.mjs) answers it, unless model: it needs a real model that runs the decks command. named: minutes long or pictures to look at; runs only when named. bench: it measures, it does not pass or fail on its own. path: where it lives after the switch-over (until then, e2e/checks/<name>.mjs).
